target: Genuine PHQ-8 total is a fitting target only; evaluation remains the original five-class mapping. Never put questionnaire labels into feature inputs.
preprocessing: Real fitting block-wise standardization, divide by sqrt(block dimension), concatenate then divide by sqrt(block count). No PCA or feature truncation. Center targets on fitting mean; predict and clip to 0..24. Linear or RBF gamma=0.5 kernel ridge, no synthetic samples.
selection: Fixed bins use 4.5/9.5/14.5/19.5; learned cuts maximize inner OOF correct count via exact ordered dynamic programming within +/-4, step0.5, gap>=1. Ties prefer minimum displacement then lower cuts. Compare 24 regressors and unchanged baseline by inner correct count, macro-F1, declared order. Both policies reported. Outer PHQ/class labels never tune or fit.
limits: Same original participants and nested folds; saved baseline reused, no validation/test scoring. No post-outer search expansion. Predictions are numerical scores plus five-class decisions, not probability estimates. Repeated exploratory development, no independent confirmation.
